historical_reviews.deepseek: Directionally aligned on the SMBIOS type, but its heading filter cannot prove battery count or capacity/voltage fields and its access wrapper is not acceptable evidence handling.

original_test_intent: Verify the complete SMBIOS Type 22 Portable Battery inventory and every applicable identity, chemistry, capacity and voltage field against the approved platform specification.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 22 structures through protected read-only OS access, preserve parser and platform identity, decode all entries and extended-capacity semantics, then compare handles and fields to the expected present-or-absent battery matrix.
manual_activity: The platform owner declares whether portable batteries are expected and supplies the per-entry field/unit matrix; an operator verifies target identity and protected access while automation performs complete read-only comparison.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/board, BIOS and SMBIOS version
Expected Type 22 handle count, present/absent battery inventory and location/designation
Design capacity, design voltage, multiplication factor and any extended-capacity semantics
Supported dmidecode/parser version and unknown/not-provided rules
Protected credential/host verification, redaction and evidence storage
safety_requirements: Keep collection read-only; do not charge, discharge, remove or reconfigure a battery
Do not alter BIOS, power policy or firmware to make data appear
Do not clear logs before relevant baseline evidence is retained
Never put passwords on the command line or disable host-key verification
Capture complete raw stdout/stderr and exit status; no heading-only grep verdict
Do not treat absent Type 22 as failure or success without the platform matrix
Stop on malformed/truncated or unit-ambiguous data and require owner interpretation
agent_execution_scope: Validate target and expected present/absent battery matrix
Collect complete raw `dmidecode --type 22` through protected access
Parse every handle and all defined strings, enums, capacity and voltage fields
Apply documented multiplication/extended-capacity semantics without inventing units
Compare absent, extra, duplicate, unknown and mismatched entries
Report evidence without power-state mutation or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the battery inventory and Type 22 field/unit semantics
Resolve absent, unknown, OEM or not-provided values
Approve any supplemental read-only battery inventory cross-check
Review evidence and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Type 22 selector is correct, but grep can hide entries and fields, while sshpass plus disabled host checking exposes credentials and weakens SUT identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected authenticated access to run unfiltered `dmidecode --type 22`, retaining complete stdout/stderr, exit status, target identity and parser version for field- and unit-aware comparison.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Type 22 scope, SPEC comparison, private script and 10/10-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: TYPE22 BATTERY AND UNIT MATRIX REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare a complete handle-indexed Type 22 inventory to the platform's explicit present/absent expectation and decode capacity using the structure's multiplication and extended-field rules before evaluating values.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds absence policy, full multi-entry parsing, unit/extended-capacity semantics, secure access and target binding.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A `Portable Battery` heading cannot establish which battery is described or whether chemistry, capacity and voltage fields are correct.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS describes design/inventory metadata rather than live state-of-charge or health; live battery telemetry is supplemental and cannot replace Type 22 coverage.

project_override_considerations: If the server design has no portable battery, the approved matrix may require zero Type 22 entries. A UPS, CMOS coin cell or BMC power-supply record must not be silently treated as a portable battery substitute.
expected_evidence: SUT/BIOS/SMBIOS/parser identity, timestamp and approved Type 22 present/absent matrix
Complete raw Type 22 stdout/stderr and exit status
Parsed handles, identity, chemistry, capacity, voltage, multiplier and applicable optional fields
Optional read-only battery telemetry cross-check and no-mutation/security audit
Engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target SMBIOS Type 22 Portable Battery data. Platform presence and expected field/unit values are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Type 22 collection and comparison are deterministic once the platform battery matrix and parser semantics are supplied.

review_improvement: Retains the correct Type 22 read while adding explicit zero-entry handling, complete fields, capacity-unit semantics and protected identity-bound evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A zero-entry Type 22 table on a rack server may be the correct inventory, while a nonzero record still requires multiplier-aware capacity interpretation. Thus both cardinality and field semantics must come from the platform matrix; decoder label presence alone is not a correctness oracle.
